query_pdb.description: Absolute path to the query structure (PDB or mmCIF) that Foldseek searches against `target_db`.

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream structure-producing tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `query_pdb` when omitted.

target_db.description: Path to a Foldseek target database directory or single-file index. Typical databases: PDB100, AlphaFold-Swissprot, AlphaFold-UniProt-50.

mode.description: Foldseek subcommand. `easy-search` finds nearest structural neighbours; `easy-cluster` groups the query (and database hits) into structural clusters.

alignment_type.description: Foldseek `--alignment-type`: 0=3di, 1=TM-align, 2=3di+aa (default), 3=tm-rescored, 4=structural global. 2 is the recommended balance of speed and quality.

e_value.description: E-value threshold (lower = stricter). Hits above this E-value are filtered out.

max_seqs.description: Maximum number of hits reported per query (`--max-seqs`).
